Basic attacks: fennec and wolf

The fennec's gate-light dart (a tiny tick, then a crystal spark), and the wolf's short bite (smaller cuts of its lunge, plus a C made just for the bite). Option A is in the game now as a placeholder for both. Pick a letter per sound, or "all A" / "all B" per mech.
